Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Content: Students researching the `text(Sun)`, `text(Earth)`, and `text(Moon)` system read about eclipses and find information on a total solar eclipse that will occur in `2024`. During a total solar eclipse, the light from the `text(Sun)` is about the same as the light from a full moon. Since stars can be seen during a full moon, the students wonder whether stars will be seen during the total solar eclipse. This information shows what they learn from doing more research.
